parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Node: V-001 and associated lines [CASE-01]. Design intent: receive crude and separate it at controlled pressure (PV-101 loop). Deviation: MORE PRESSURE in the crude input line/V-001 [CASE-02]. Recognized causes: PV-101 loop failing closed; spurious SDV-30010 trip [P2]. Consequence of interest: V-001 overpressure with flammable release, injury, oil spill and production loss [P3]. Safeguards: redundant PSV-101 A/B and PAHH-102 closing SDV-30010 [CASE-03, P1]. Likelihood: generic order-of-magnitude values, not plant data, were used (BPCS loop failure ~0.1/yr; spurious SDV closure ~0.1-0.5/yr). On that basis an initiating demand within 30 operating days is ~1-5%. Reaching the target event also requires PSV failure (PFD ~1e-2 to 1e-3) and failure of PAHH-102 where it is independent of the cause (PFD ~1e-1 to 1e-2). It then requires loss of containment, injury and spill. This yields roughly 1e-7 to 1e-3 over the horizon; 0.01% is a conservative mean-type point estimate. No diagnostic trend, verified fault or confirmed event existed at the decision point [P3], so nothing flagged this window. The hazard type was foreseeable as a recognized HAZOP scenario, but occurrence within 30 days was not predictable (~5%). Own qualitative classification, since the article rating is withheld [CASE-04]: high severity and low likelihood with two protection layers, i.e. medium priority for verification rather than an evident deficiency. Negligence: the hazard and causes were recognized and layered protection was in place. No ignored warning, bypass or known defect is documented, so no negligence is attributable on the pre-event record. The outcome was not used as evidence and does not revise these estimates. Recommendations: verify PSV-101 A/B relief-case sizing (blocked outlet) and duty/spare configuration. Confirm SDV-30010 location and that the crude input line is rated for, or protected against, shut-in pressure on spurious closure. Confirm PAHH-102 independence from the PV-101 loop and from the SDV-30010 spurious-trip cause. Sustain proof testing and bypass control of PSV-101 A/B and PAHH-102/SDV-30010.
